body_en:
[The opening of this record is corrupted in the source: stray Latin letters and broken letter-elongation have been inserted into the Arabic, so that the first two lines are only partly legible. What can be read is rendered here, with the damaged stretches marked.]

Works and recording[s … text corrupted …] by the Shei[kh] Mu[h]ammad al-Hasan al-Dedew — may God preserve him — will be exhibited at the International [Book] Fair of this [year] in Riyadh, which is organised by the Cultural Affairs Sector of the Ministry of Culture and Information during the month of Rabi al-Awwal 1432 AH.

Mu'assasat al-Ummah for Publishing and Distribution in Riyadh will have sole charge of exhibiting these works and recordings at its own stand at the international fair. The Sheikh's exhibited items consist of two new books: Nathr al-Ifādāt ʿalā Matn al-Waraqāt, which is a commentary on the text of the book al-Waraqāt of Imam al-Haramayn; and al-Nahr al-ʿAdhb, which is the second release in this series and comprises six lectures on governance in accordance with the Sharia (al-siyāsah al-sharʿiyyah). The foundation will also exhibit an album in the form of an audio disc containing the second part of the programme "Mafāhīm", which hosts the Sheikh on "4Shabab channel" throughout the days of the month of Ramadan…
